audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers said Skill for levels 1 through 4-5 and Locke at level 6, while every whys[] line says Darius owns the early lane and level 6 is even. The packet chart agrees with the prose, not the tokens.
audit.why: A juggernaut with a 535-range pull and a healing Q owns the range band a 950-range marker has to walk into. Level 6 is a mutual execute spike, not a Locke spike. The mirror audit settled on this exact chart.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 flipped to Darius and row 4 to Skill in BOTH layers, with ratings dropped to 4/10 and 5/10. EVEN 5.5/10 overall kept — 49.33% over 1425 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Only poke when his E is on cooldown' appeared repeatedly with no cooldown attached, and Noxian Guillotine's refresh was described vaguely as a 'reset game'.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — the longest cooldown in his kit and a genuinely large window for a champion with a flat 10s blink. Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80s and refreshes on a killing blow, and it costs no mana at rank 3.
audit.corrected: 26s stated in spikes[0] and early; the kill-refresh stated plainly in spikes[1] and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: His E was called 'Apprehension' throughout; Locke's Q was called Ritual Nails and his passive Silver Stake; and late claimed Ashen Pursuit has a takedown reset.
audit.why: The ability is Apprehend, and its passive half also gives Darius percent armour penetration — armour alone does not answer him. Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s in Locke's kit file with no reset condition in the text; the mirror removed the same claim from the other side.
audit.corrected: Apprehend used, Soul Nails used, the passive described by its missing-health on-hit effect, and the false E reset deleted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decimate heals Darius off every champion hit by the blade, and Apprehend's passive shreds armour — neither reaches the content layer.
audit.why: It makes Grievous Wounds a real early buy and tells you why stacking armour into him underperforms. report[8] already says to add anti-heal; the content layer never explained why.
audit.corrected: The blade heal is now the reason given in early for refusing the extended trade.

edits.before: Purgatory online: top lane's long brawls now end at YOUR floor. Anyone who all-ins you under a third is volunteering for the totem.
edits.after: Both executes arrive together: Purgatory sets a floor, Noxian Guillotine refreshes on a kill. Even, and it swings on whose lands first.

edits.before: Darius owns this range band — his Q Decimate outer-blade heal and W Crippling Strike slow mean any time you step in to Q Ritual Nails, he can pull with E Apprehension and start stacking Hemorrhage bleed on you.
edits.after: Darius owns this range band — Q Decimate's blade heals him and W Crippling Strike slows, so any step in to Q Soul Nails invites E Apprehend, 26s at rank 1, and the Hemorrhage bleed that follows.

edits.before: Level 6 evens out: your R Purgatory execute totem answers Darius's own Noxian Guillotine game, so the all-in becomes a coin flip on whose execute lands — respect his E pull and 5-stack bleed reset.
edits.after: Level 6 evens out: your R Purgatory answers Darius's Noxian Guillotine, which refreshes on a killing blow, so the all-in is a coin flip on whose execute lands — respect Apprehend and the 5-stack bleed.

edits.before: Late game is even on positioning — if Darius lands E Apprehension into full bleed he kills you, but your R execute and E Ashen Pursuit reset let you pick him if he steps up alone.
edits.after: Late game is even on positioning — a landed E Apprehend into full bleed kills you, but your R execute and a flat 10s E Ashen Pursuit let you pick him whenever he steps up alone.

edits.before: Levels 1-4 belong to Darius. His Q Decimate outer-edge heals him in every trade and his E Apprehension can yank you out of position the moment you step up to Q Ritual Nails, letting him stack Hemorrhage and win the bleed war. Farm at max range, only take Q pokes when his E is on cooldown, and never sit in melee range where W Crippling Strike slows your escape.
edits.after: Levels 1-4 belong to Darius. Q Decimate's blade heals him off every trade and E Apprehend yanks you out of position the moment you step up to Q Soul Nails, letting him stack Hemorrhage and win the bleed war. Farm at max range, poke only in the 26s Apprehend is down, and never sit in melee where W Crippling Strike slows your escape.

edits.before: Level 6 evens the fight. Your R Purgatory execute totem trades identity with Darius's Noxian Guillotine — the all-in becomes a coin flip on whose execute connects first. Make sure his E pull is down before you commit, because being apprehended into a bleed stack still kills you even with your ult up.
edits.after: Level 6 evens the fight. Your R Purgatory trades identity with Darius's Noxian Guillotine, which refreshes on a kill — the all-in is a coin flip on whose execute connects first. Confirm E Apprehend is spent before you commit, because a pull into full bleed kills you with your ultimate still up.

edits.before: Your first AP item tips things your way: R threshold plus W Soul Ignition and P Silver Stake missing-HP procs can convert a caught Darius before his Guillotine resets. Deeper into items it's even and positioning-decided — E Ashen Pursuit's takedown reset lets you dodge his pull and re-engage, but one clean E Apprehension into full Hemorrhage still deletes you.
edits.after: Your first AP item tips things your way: the R threshold plus W Soul Ignition and your missing-HP on-hits convert a caught Darius before Guillotine refreshes. Deeper into items it is even and positioning-decided — a flat 10s E Ashen Pursuit dodges the pull and re-engages, but one clean E Apprehend into full Hemorrhage still deletes you.

edits.before: Bait his E Apprehension then E Ashen Pursuit away from the bleed
edits.after: Bait his E Apprehend, then Ashen Pursuit away from the bleed

edits.before: Land E Apprehension pull to start Hemorrhage stacks
edits.after: Land E Apprehend's pull to start Hemorrhage stacks

notes: The chart rows were proposed as one atomic group with their ratings, matched full/content pairs. The full layer's focus ability is written 'Apprehend (Pull)', which is correct and left alone — only the content layer used the invented 'Apprehension'. Unverified and deliberately not written: whether Purgatory's binding can stop the Noxian Guillotine leap. Riot's text calls Purgatory a 'binding artifact' and the kit carries a grounding flag, but the interaction is not spelled out, and the mirror flagged the same claim for a wiki check.
